title: Walsh character on concatenated cubes
statement: Let $a,x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ and $b,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^m$. The vector Walsh character indexed by the concatenation of $a$ and $b$, evaluated at the concatenation of $x$ and $y$, equals the product of the vector Walsh characters indexed by $a$ and $b$, evaluated at $x$ and $y$, respectively.
